coverage.definition: pair coverage = labeled pairs / (dataset records x taxonomy skills); annotated records = distinct source ids with at least one label

definitions.coverage: labeled pairs over all dataset-record x taxonomy-skill pairs, plus annotated records
definitions.macro: unweighted mean of per-skill precision/recall/F1 over taxonomy skills with at least one non-uncertain labeled pair; skills with no defined value (all labels not_supported) are excluded and listed explicitly
definitions.primary_micro: pair-level contingency pooled over all non-uncertain labeled pairs: supported+predicted=TP, supported+not predicted=FN, not_supported+predicted=FP, not_supported+not predicted=TN; precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2*P*R/(P+R) with safe zero denominators
definitions.uncertain: ambiguous mentions reported separately and excluded from every primary denominator

guardrails: labels are draft, not gold or human-reviewed; metrics are provisional
uncertain labels are excluded from all primary denominators and reported separately
unlabeled pairs are excluded from the metrics, never treated as false positives or negatives
not_supported means no explicit positive evidence in the reviewed fields, never that the person or job lacks the skill
no market coverage: one page of one job board is not a market snapshot
limitations: development sample: exactly 20 records from one page (limit=20, offset=0) of one source, snapshot cap_0370798f7af4b0e3, complete: false; this is not a full feed and not market coverage
label coverage is partial: 56 of 740 non-uncertain labeled pairs in this draft set
the keyword baseline 0.1.0 does not parse negation; the draft false positives are AI mentions in roles that explicitly state AI experience is not required
no semantic, LLM, or embedding analysis was used for labels or predictions

macro.scope_note: macro scope: taxonomy skills with at least one non-uncertain labeled pair; per-skill precision/recall/F1 are computed over that skill's own labeled pairs and then averaged unweighted over the skills whose value is defined; a skill whose labels are all not_supported has no positive gold or prediction and no defined per-skill metric

micro.scope_note: micro metrics pool all non-uncertain labeled pairs (each pair contributes equally); identical to the primary metrics by definition

primary.note: primary metrics pool every non-uncertain labeled pair (micro); precision/recall are undefined (None) when the denominator is zero, F1 is 0.0 when at least one of them is defined as 0

uncertain.excluded_note: uncertain labels are reported separately and excluded from all primary denominators and from the macro scope

predictions_summary.note: predicted pairs without a label are excluded from the metrics entirely; they are never treated as false positives or negatives

limitations: development_sample: exactly 20 records from one bounded page (limit=20, offset=0) of one source (himalayas), snapshot cap_0370798f7af4b0e3, complete: false
not market coverage: one page of one job board is not a market snapshot and no whole-market claim is made
sample.warning: development_sample: 20 records, one page, complete: false; not a full feed and not market coverage

warnings: draft_evaluation: labels were independently drafted from direct source-text inspection and are NOT human-reviewed or gold; every metric on this report is provisional
this draft contains no false negatives (FN=0): the curated positives were chosen where the keyword baseline is strong; this reflects the curated draft set, not the market
